content: Kristin Neff's self-compassion research: self-kindness + common humanity + mindfulness after a setback reduces shame and the 'what-the-hell effect' (one lapse becoming a full relapse). Self-compassion correlates with more responsibility-taking after failure and mastery goals rather than performance/self-image protection. A smoking-cessation RCT found self-compassion training outperformed monitoring-only, especially among highly self-critical participants. Distinct from and complementary to Marlatt's abstinence violation effect (AVE) literature: AVE's guilt/shame/internal-attribution triad after a lapse predicts progression to full relapse; self-compassion interventions are the studied antidote.
